summary: Shivansh Charak is a software engineer with a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science from Vishwakarma University. He works remotely at Foundry AI, developing scalable backend services for a multi-tenant LMS. His expertise includes building production-grade RAG pipelines, implementing hybrid search solutions, and using technologies like PostgreSQL, OpenAI embeddings, and PydanticAI. His work focuses on enterprise knowledge retrieval and AI-assisted code generation.
